header: Step 3: Ingest data into the data stream
content:
To ingest data into a data stream, you can use the regular indexing APIs. Make sure every
document that you index has a timestamp ﬁeld. If you try to ingest a document that doesn’t have a
timestamp ﬁeld, you get an error.
POST logs-redis/_doc
{
"message": "login attempt",
"@timestamp": "2013-03-01T00:00:00"
}
